question: Change the metric accumulator to use a new AccumulatedMetric type instead of raw pmetric.Metric. The accumulator bridges OTel metrics to Prometheus exposition format and is used indirectly by Jaeger (for span metrics) and Grafana (for OTLP ingestion). Any code that reads accumulated metrics will break.

answer.explanation: The metric accumulator is defined in accumulator.go with an accumulatedValue struct (line 42-56) that stores 'value pmetric.Metric' and an accumulator interface (line 59-65) whose Collect() method returns '[]pmetric.Metric'. The lastValueAccumulator.Collect() (line 397-426) iterates over registeredMetrics and builds a []pmetric.Metric slice. Changing pmetric.Metric to a new AccumulatedMetric type would break: (1) accumulator.go itself — the accumulatedValue struct field, interface definition, all accumulate* methods (accumulateGauge, accumulateSum, accumulateHistogram, accumulateSummary, accumulateExponentialHistogram) that store pmetric.Metric values, and the Collect() return type; (2) collector.go — the Collect() method (line 605-633) calls c.accumulator.Collect() and receives []pmetric.Metric, then passes each metric to convertMetric() (line 178) which dispatches to type-specific converters (convertGauge, convertSum, convertDoubleHistogram, convertExponentialHistogram, convertSummary) all of which take pmetric.Metric parameters; (3) all test files that create, accumulate, and assert on pmetric.Metric values through the accumulator and collector interfaces.

accumulator.go.changes_needed: Change accumulatedValue.value type from pmetric.Metric to AccumulatedMetric. Update accumulator interface Collect() return type. Update lastValueAccumulator.Collect() return type. Update all accumulate* methods that create and store pmetric.Metric in accumulatedValue.

collector.go.changes_needed: Update Collect() method to handle new AccumulatedMetric type instead of pmetric.Metric from accumulator.Collect(). Update convertMetric() and all type-specific convert methods (convertGauge, convertSum, convertDoubleHistogram, convertExponentialHistogram, convertSummary) to accept AccumulatedMetric instead of pmetric.Metric.
